sentence: Hoje não faz sol nem calor.
ipa: ˈɔʒɨ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈfaʃ ˈsɔɫ ˈnɐ̃j̃ kɐˈloɾ
gloss_en: Today it is neither sunny nor hot.
notes: Velarised coda [ɫ] in 'sol' and coda [ʃ] in 'faz' per cruzferreira1995; unstressed reduction [ˈɔʒɨ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O bilhete custa doze euros e meio.
ipa: o biˈʎɛtɨ ˈkuʃtɐ ˈdɔzɨ ˈewɾuz i ˈmeju
gloss_en: The ticket costs twelve euros fifty.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'bilhete' and coda [ʃ] in 'custa' per cruzferreira1995; 'euros e' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Tenho consulta na quinta-feira às nove horas.
ipa: ˈtɛɲu kõˈsuɫtɐ nɐ ˈkĩtɐ ˈfejɾɐ aʒ ˈnɔvɨ ˈɔɾɐʃ
gloss_en: I have an appointment on Thursday at nine.
notes: Nasal [ɲ]/[ẽ] and 'às nove' sibilant voicing to [ʒ] per mateus_dandrade2000; coda [ʃ] per cruzferreira1995.

sentence: A minha família mora numa aldeia pequena.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ fɐˈmiliɐ ˈmɔɾɐ ˈnumɐ ɐˈɫdejɐ pɨˈkɛnɐ
gloss_en: My family lives in a small village.
notes: Palatal [ɲ] and reduced pretonic vowels per mateus_dandrade2000; coda [ɫ] in 'aldeia' per cruzferreira1995.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue sempre em frente.
ipa: ˈviɾɐ a diˈɾejtɐ i ˈsɛɡɨ ˈsẽpɾɨ ɐ̃j̃ ˈfɾẽtɨ
gloss_en: Turn right and keep going straight ahead.
notes: 'ei' diphthong retained and 'à direita' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000; imperative register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Este bacalhau está muito salgado.
ipa: ˈeʃtɨ bɐkɐˈʎaw eˈʃta ˈmujtu sɐˈɫɡadu
gloss_en: This cod is very salty.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'bacalhau' and coda [ɫ] in 'salgado' per cruzferreira1995; coda [ʃ] in 'este'/'está' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Onde fica a estação de comboios?
ipa: ˈõdɨ ˈfikɐ ɐ eʃtɐˈsɐ̃w̃ dɨ kõˈbojuʃ
gloss_en: Where is the train station?
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'estação' and coda [ʃ] per cruzferreira1995; interrogative per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quantos quilos de pão queres?
ipa: ˈkwɐ̃tuʃ ˈkiluʒ dɨ ˈpɐ̃w̃ ˈkɛɾɨʃ
gloss_en: How many kilos of bread do you want?
notes: Nasal diphthongs [ɐ̃w̃] and coda [ʃ]/[ʒ] per cruzferreira1995; quantifier interrogative per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Se chovesse, ficávamos em casa.
ipa: sɨ ʃuˈvɛs̺ɨ fiˈkavɐmuz ɐ̃j̃ ˈkazɐ
gloss_en: If it rained, we would stay home.
notes: [ʃ] onset in 'chovesse' and open-mid [ɛ] per cruzferreira1995; conditional-imperfect frame per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Ontem comprei peixe fresco no mercado.
ipa: ˈõtɐ̃j̃ kõˈpɾej ˈpejʃɨ ˈfɾeʃku nu mɨˈɾkadu
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought fresh fish at the market.
notes: 'ei' diphthong in 'comprei'/'peixe' and coda [ʃ] per cruzferreira1995; nasal [õ]/[ẽ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Para o ano vou viajar até ao Porto.
ipa: ˈpaɾɐ o ˈɐnu ˈvo viɐˈʒaɾ ɐˈtɛ ɐu ˈpoɾtu
gloss_en: Next year I will travel to Porto.
notes: 'até ao' vowel liaison and 'vou' [o] monophthong per mateus_dandrade2000; 'Porto' coda tap [ɾ] per cruzferreira1995.

sentence: Liga-me mais tarde, por favor.
ipa: ˈliɡɐ mɨ ˈmajʃ ˈtaɾdɨ puɾ fɐˈvɔɾ
gloss_en: Call me later, please.
notes: Coda [ʃ] in 'mais' and open-mid [ɔ] in 'por'/'favor' per cruzferreira1995; clitic imperative per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Olá, tudo bem contigo?
ipa: oˈla ˈtudu ˈbɐ̃j̃ kõˈtiɡu
gloss_en: Hi, are you doing well?
notes: Nasal [ẽ] in 'bem' and close-mid vowels per mateus_dandrade2000; greeting register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quem não arrisca, não petisca.
ipa: ˈkɐ̃j̃ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ɐˈʁiʃkɐ ˈnɐ̃w̃ pɨˈtiʃkɐ
gloss_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
notes: Strong [ʁ] from 'rr' in 'arrisca' and coda [ʃ] per cruzferreira1995; proverb attested in cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: O sol pôs-se atrás da montanha.
ipa: o ˈsɔɫ ˈpoʃ sɨ ɐˈtɾaʒ dɐ mõˈtaɲɐ
gloss_en: The sun set behind the mountain.
notes: Velarised coda [ɫ] in 'sol', close-mid [o] in 'pôs' and coda [ʒ] in 'atrás' per cruzferreira1995; palatal [ɲ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Ele trouxe um ramo de flores roxas.
ipa: ˈelɨ ˈtɾosɨ ˈũ ˈʁamu dɨ ˈflɔɾɨʒ ˈʁɔʃɐʃ
gloss_en: He brought a bunch of red flowers.
notes: Strong [ʁ] word-initial in 'ramo'/'roxas' and 'ou' diphthong per cruzferreira1995; coda [ʒ]/[ʃ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A velha ponte de pedra ainda aguenta.
ipa: ɐ ˈvɛʎɐ ˈpõtɨ dɨ ˈpɛdɾɐ ˈaj̃dɐ ɐˈɡẽtɐ
gloss_en: The old stone bridge still holds.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'velha' and nasal [õ] per cruzferreira1995; open-mid [ɛ] in 'pedra' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Aquele rapaz vende jornais na esquina.
ipa: ɐˈkɛlɨ ʁɐˈpaʒ ˈvẽdɨ ʒuˈɾnajʒ nɐ eˈʃkinɐ
gloss_en: That young man sells newspapers on the corner.
notes: Strong [ʁ] word-initial in 'rapaz', coda [ʒ] in 'jornais' and coda [ʃ] in 'esquina' per cruzferreira1995.

sentence: O melhor vinho branco vem do Douro.
ipa: o mɨˈʎɔɾ ˈviɲu ˈbɾɐ̃ku ˈvɐ̃j̃ du ˈdoɾu
gloss_en: The best white wine comes from the Douro.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'melhor', open-mid [ɔ] and 'ou' diphthong in 'Douro' per cruzferreira1995; nasal [ɐ̃] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Nunca vi um céu tão azul.
ipa: ˈnũkɐ ˈvi ˈũ ˈsɛw ˈtɐ̃w̃ ɐˈzuɫ
gloss_en: I never saw such a blue sky.
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'tão', open-mid [ɛ] in 'céu' and coda [ɫ] in 'azul' per cruzferreira1995.
